answer: Use one anonymous admission pass per independently verified operator. A registrar checks an applicant once, then signs a credential. At each grant round the applicant proves possession and reveals a round-specific tag derived from that credential. The ledger rejects a repeated tag even if bids arrive under yarrow, saffron and plume. A farm seeking ten votes must recruit ten verified operators or corrupt the registrar; making ten new keys is cheap but earns no extra passes.
